text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDX-783 fired for cuda_alloc_failure on gpu-pool-west2a. severity=high. affected_customers=2, degraded=1. Trigger: nvml OOM spike.

anya: Acked. I'm on it, grabbing traces and nvml dumps.

pagerduty: PDX-783 acknowledged by anya at 22:14 UTC; escalation schedule unchanged.

jamie: quick check — kvcache eviction rate spiked ~22:12, p95 alloc latency up. nvml shows GPU memory at 98% on gnode-17.

matt: logs from gnode-17:
```
2026-03-17T22:12:30Z ERROR cuda: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: alloc 2147483648
model: large-v4, sequence_len=2048
kvcache: miss_rate=0.62, evictions=4283/5m
```

matt: I'll cordon gnode-17 and reroute incoming infer to fallback pool (gpu-pool-west2b) to stop new allocations.

anya: running cordon and drain commands now:
```
kubectl cordon gnode-17
kubectl drain gnode-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=5m
```

incident-bot: autopager action triggered: reroute policy applied (fallback model small-v2) for requests matching /v1/infer/large-v4. ETA stabilization 3m.

leo: Customer impact: AcmePay (acct: acme-pay-prod) seeing ~5% 503s since 22:13 UTC. Support notified and applying rate-limits for non-critical workloads.

anya: evict script started, monitoring mem and kvcache metrics; will update in 2m. If load doesn't drop we'll scale dedicated pool by +2 GPUs.

jamie: we should also check quantized-model fallback readiness. If the fallback small-v2 degrades latency, we may need canary rollout.

matt: cordon/drain completed, new allocs routed. memory on gnode-17 dropping, kvcache evictions decreasing.

anya: 22:20 UTC: stabilization observed. customer errors reduced to baseline after reroute. Handing off monitoring to leo (night oncall) at 22:45 UTC if stable.

leo: ack handoff. I'll keep watch for 2h and create a follow-up ticket to run a root-cause test (kvcache sizing + eviction policy). Posting links to dashboards: https://redwood.app/dash/gpu-west2a

jamie: follow-up action items: (1) postmortem if repeat within 7d; (2) consider increasing auto-evict threshold from 80%->85% for this pool; (3) add alert to correlate kvcache eviction spikes with nvml OOM.

anya: thanks team. closing incident in PD once Leo confirms stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Note: PD incident PDX-783 will auto-resolve if no further alerts in 30m.
